name: Misguided
description: All his life, Paul (Paul Gosselin) wanted to be an actor on the daytime drama, Guiding Light, but after CBS canceled the series following a 72-year run, Paul thought it was high time to pack up his life in New York City and move to Los Angeles. While in the City of Angels, home to the now four remaining US soap operas, Paul seeks out wisdom and inspiration in navigating this disappearing industry from the one person he believes has all of the answers, Susan Lucci, aka "Big Sue."

videos.title: The Best Friend
videos.overview: With Guiding Light canceled, Paul left New York City and moved to Los Angeles. Searching for inspiration, he found his way to the one person who understands his passion for the soap opera genre, Big Sue.

videos.title: The Casting Director
videos.overview: Once upon a time, Paul was straight. He had a relationship with a beautiful, exotic woman named Breeze, who now turns out is a casting director for a soap opera in Los Angeles. Only problem is, Paul never told Breeze he's gay. Can Paul continue to play the part of straight guy to land a role on a daytime drama?

videos.title: The Writer
videos.overview: Paul finds himself figuring out life once again after his awkward re-connection with Breeze, This time, he's planning on wowing a writer from The Bold and the Beautiful by sharing his Guiding Light stories live on stage. Things don't turn out quite how Paul anticipated, and he finds himself at a bar, alone, in another situation that doesn't seem to go the way he anticipated.

videos.title: The Actresses
videos.overview: Paul shares with Big Sue a recent story about what happened during a ride-share experience. Paul's life in starting to spiral downward as there are very few places to turn and he's realizing it day by day.

videos.title: The Diva
videos.overview: On his way out to visit Big Sue, Paul and Stephanie have a conversation in the kitchen about dreams. Stephanie attempts to cheer Paul up by giving him one of her "all natural/minus the pills" smoothies which sends Paul into a crazy dream sequence that Big Sue must have also inspired.

videos.title: The Meeting
videos.overview: After being called into the office of Hollywood agent Jeva Jones, Paul realizes his dream of being a soap star on "Guiding Light" is actually still attainable.

videos.title: The Audition
videos.overview: Paul is auditioning for the role of his life, a chance to make his dream come true and be a part of Guiding Light... technically it's being called A Springfield Story, but that's not stopping him. Will a former love stand in his way between him and his dream role?

videos.title: The Visit
videos.overview: Waking up beside his NSA arch nemesis, Paul and Bauer's morning tryst is cut short by an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Who is Paul's mom and what secret has she been keeping from him. Jeva Jones knows, but how will this affect Paul's dream of being a soap opera star?

videos.title: The Dream
videos.overview: Stephanie finds Paul passed out on the front door step. Has this all been a dream? What about Susan Coochie, where has she been this entire time?

videos.title: The Reboot
videos.overview: A year after the "smoothie accident" Paul is back at Big Sue's star ready to tell his story... a story of reigniting the light.

videos.title: The Beginning
videos.overview: Paul & Doyle's relationship had to start somewhere, journey back to the beginning and see how it all began. Also Paul runs into an old flame, too bad he doesn't remembers her and shares with her some devastating news.

videos.title: The Memories
videos.overview: Paul is ready to start his newly rebooted life with Doyle, but first he has to say goodbye to those who don't want him to leave.

videos.title: The Engagement
videos.overview: Now that Paul has his memories and his man, their future is looking promising and he can't wait to share the news with the two most important women in his life.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Paul and Doyle's wedding day has arrived. Will the big day go off without any drama, or will Tamara and Doyle's successfully complete their mission?

videos.title: The Answers
videos.overview: It's been weeks since Paul & Doyle's wedding and Paul still doesn't have any answers as to why this happened? Was Breeze in on Tamara's plan all along or does someone else hold the answers?
